definition_points: Accumulated neutral tritium introduced by gas injection during prefill before plasma breakdown.
Expressed as an equivalent-electron count, with one equivalent electron per tritium atom and two per neutral diatomic tritium molecule.
Defined by the integral of the tritium introduction rate from prefill start t0 to plasma breakdown t_bd.
Excludes post-breakdown gas injection, wall recycling, neutral-beam fueling, and pellet fueling.
Counts injected tritium, not retained or ionized tritium inventory; the equivalent-electron convention is an accounting normalization, not a free-electron count.
Relates as the tritium contribution to accumulated_total_prefill_gas_equivalent_electron_count and contrasts with accumulated_tritium_count_due_to_gas_injection.
detected photoelectron rate assigned to each wavelength pixel of a spectrometer channel
